title: The Sloth Who Lost the Moon

characters.name: Mo
characters.look: a small sleepy three-toed sloth in a knitted blue scarf, big kind eyes

characters.name: Pip
characters.look: a tiny glowing firefly with round spectacles and a lantern-shaped tail

characters.name: Ottoline
characters.look: a wise old barn owl wearing a patchwork shawl and a pocket watch

scenes.title: The Porch
scenes.background_prompt: a wooden treehouse porch high in a jungle tree at night, empty dark sky, hanging lanterns

lines.text: Every night, Mo the sloth fell asleep watching the moon.
But tonight, the sky was empty.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: The moon... it's gone!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Psst! Down here! I saw something shiny roll into the Whispering Woods.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Rolled? The moon doesn't roll. ...Does it?
Where should Mo look first?

choices.text: Follow Pip into the Whispering Woods
Climb down to ask Ottoline at the Old Oak

scenes.title: The Whispering Woods
scenes.background_prompt: a misty glowing forest path with giant ferns and blue mushrooms at night

lines.text: The woods hummed with tiny voices.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Stay close. The trees here gossip.
Something silver glinted under a pile of leaves.

scenes.title: The Old Oak
scenes.background_prompt: a huge ancient oak tree with a round door and a lit window, starry clearing

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: Hoo. A sloth awake at night? This must be serious.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: The moon is missing. Have you seen it?

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: The moon never goes missing, little one. It only hides when it's sad.
Ottoline offers you tea.

scenes.title: Fog Hollow
scenes.background_prompt: a hollow filled with thick silver fog, faint shapes of trees, mysterious

lines.text: Fog swallowed the path.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I... can't see my own glow.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Then I'll carry you. Slowly. Very slowly.
Mo hears a soft sob in the fog.

choices.text: Hum a lullaby to calm everyone

scenes.title: Firefly Glade
scenes.background_prompt: a glade full of hundreds of dancing fireflies, magical golden light

lines.text: A thousand fireflies rose like sparks.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: My cousins! They're throwing a party!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: They say the moon came by earlier... looking lonely.
Pip's cousins look so happy.

choices.text: Ask them to help find the moon

scenes.title: Mirror Lake
scenes.background_prompt: a perfectly still lake reflecting the stars, reeds, a small wooden dock

lines.text: At the lake, the water was so still it looked like a second sky.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Look! The moon is in the water!

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: Or is it?
The moon, who had only felt forgotten, rose back into the sky.

lines.speaker: mo
lines.text: Goodnight, moon. We'll watch you every night.
The moon floated down from its hiding place in the lake and hugged everyone, very carefully.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: Hoo. Kindness, it seems, is brighter than any lantern.
From that night on, the moon visited the porch every Sunday for tea.
Mo sat on the dock to think... and fell asleep for three days.
When Mo woke up, the moon was back. Nobody ever found out where it went.

style: soft storybook watercolor, warm lantern light, gentle pastel night palette
